mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.keyword, r.category_id, c.name AS category_name, r.tag, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions t WHERE t.user_id = r.user_id AND LOWER(t.merchant) LIKE '%' || LOWER(r.keyword) || '%') AS applied_count FROM mapping_rules r LEFT JOIN categories c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.id DESC
SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.keyword, r.category_id, c.name AS category_name, r.tag, 0 AS applied_count FROM mapping_rules r LEFT JOIN categories c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mapping_rules (user_id, keyword, category_id, tag) VALUES (#{userId}, #{keyword}, #{categoryId}, #{tag})
mapper.update: UPDATE transactions SET category_id = #{categoryId}, tag = #{tag}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND LOWER(merchant) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND category_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND LOWER(merchant) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND category_id IS NULL

SELECT t.id, CAST(t.transaction_date AS VARCHAR) AS transactionDate, t.merchant, t.amount, c.name AS currentCategory FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category_id = c.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND LOWER(t.merchant) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' AND t.category_id IS NULL ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT SUBSTRING(merchant, 1, 6) AS keyword, COUNT(*) AS occurrences, SUM(amount) AS totalAmount FROM transactions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category_id IS NULL GROUP BY SUBSTRING(merchant, 1, 6) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY occurrences DESC, totalAmount DESC LIMIT 20
